evals.prompt: In my Next.js app (shadcn already set up, @/ alias), add a line chart to the analytics dashboard showing daily users and sessions over the last 30 days, with a tooltip.
evals.expected_output: Installs @bklit/line-chart with the shadcn CLI, then a client component that composes LineChart > Grid > two Line series > XAxis > ChartTooltip, importing from @/components/charts/* files.
expectations: Runs or recommends `npx shadcn@latest add @bklit/line-chart` (or the project's package-runner equivalent) instead of hand-writing SVG
Imports from installed files such as `@/components/charts/line-chart`, `@/components/charts/x-axis`, `@/components/charts/tooltip` — never from `@bklitui/ui/charts` or `@/components/ui/line-chart`
Grid, Line, XAxis and ChartTooltip are children of a single LineChart root, with Grid before the series
Data uses Date objects under the `date` key (or sets `xDataKey` to match)
Series colors use theme tokens (var(--chart-1), var(--chart-2) or chartCssVars), not hex literals

evals.prompt: Customize the tooltip on my bklit area chart so it shows the date as 'Mon, Jan 6' and the revenue formatted as USD.
evals.expected_output: Uses ChartTooltip `content` with the ({ point, index }) signature (formatting point.date itself) or the `rows` prop returning { color, label, value }.
expectations: Uses ChartTooltip `content` or `rows` rather than building a tooltip outside the chart
The `content` callback destructures only `point` and/or `index` — it does not rely on a `formattedDate` or `payload` argument
Formats the date from `point.date` (e.g. toLocaleDateString / Intl.DateTimeFormat)
Uses Intl.NumberFormat or equivalent for USD formatting
Custom tooltip surface uses theme tokens (bg-popover/text-popover-foreground or --chart-tooltip-*) rather than hardcoded colors

evals.prompt: Build a real-time price ticker chart that updates every second from a websocket using bklit.
evals.expected_output: Installs @bklit/live-line-chart and composes LiveLineChart with LiveLine, LiveXAxis, LiveYAxis and ChartTooltip, passing data ({ time: unixSeconds, value }) and the latest `value`.
expectations: Uses LiveLineChart as the root
Uses LiveLine as the series (not Line) and LiveXAxis/LiveYAxis (not XAxis/YAxis)
Passes both `data` (array of { time, value } with time in Unix seconds) and the latest `value` prop to LiveLineChart
Appends new points and trims the array (e.g. slice) instead of rebuilding history every tick
Any use of `paused` or `window` is correct (`paused` freezes scrolling, `window` is seconds)

evals.prompt: Add release annotations (v1.0 on Jan 5, v1.1 on Feb 2) to my bklit line chart, with details shown when hovering that date.
evals.expected_output: Installs @bklit/markers; renders ChartMarkers as a sibling of ChartTooltip inside LineChart and puts marker content (filtered with useActiveMarkers) inside ChartTooltip children.
expectations: Installs or references `@bklit/markers`
ChartMarkers is a direct child of LineChart and a sibling of ChartTooltip — not nested inside ChartTooltip
Hover details are rendered as ChartTooltip children using useActiveMarkers (optionally with MarkerTooltipContent)
Marker objects include `date` (Date), `icon`, and `title`
Imports come from `@/components/charts/markers` (or the project alias), not `@bklitui/ui/charts`

evals.prompt: My app uses a custom shadcn theme with brand --chart-1 to --chart-5 colors. Will installing bklit charts overwrite them? And how do I make the chart grid lighter in dark mode?
evals.expected_output: Explains that shadcn add merges registry cssVars without overwriting existing variables, so the brand --chart-1..5 survive and only missing --chart-* tokens are added; dark grid is changed by overriding --chart-grid in .dark.
expectations: States that existing --chart-1..--chart-5 are not overwritten by installing @bklit components
Explains that chart-context only adds missing --chart-* tokens
Recommends overriding --chart-grid inside a .dark selector in CSS
Does not suggest adding dark: Tailwind classes to chart SVG elements

evals.prompt: Add a KPI stat card with a sparkline showing monthly revenue to my dashboard using bklit.
evals.expected_output: Recommends the stat-card-area-01 (or stat-card-line-01) block, which is built on @bklit/sparkline, or composes an AreaSparkline/LineSparkline from @bklit/sparkline in a shadcn Card (not a full AreaChart/LineChart with hidden axes), showing the hovered month's revenue via useSparklineHover and noting the block's barrel and sample-data files.
expectations: Mentions an existing block (`@bklit/stat-card-area-01` or `@bklit/stat-card-line-01`) or installs `@bklit/sparkline` rather than hand-rolled SVG
When composing by hand, uses AreaSparkline or LineSparkline imported from @/components/charts/sparkline with data + dataKey, not AreaChart/LineChart with axes removed
Does not add ChartTooltip, Grid or axes to the sparkline; shows the hovered value with useSparklineHover (hover.datum) or leaves the latest value static
If using a block, notes that it needs shadcn card/badge and writes components/charts/index.ts plus sample data that may need merging or replacing
Uses theme tokens for colors
Does not import from `@bklitui/ui/charts`

evals.prompt: Add a brush / range selector under my bklit area chart so users can zoom into a date range. Install whatever is needed.
evals.expected_output: Explains that ChartBrush / ChartBrushLayout are not distributed by any @bklit registry item, so there is no install command; points to the brush docs and suggests xDomain-based zoom as an alternative.
expectations: Does not run or recommend a non-existent install command such as `@bklit/brush` or `@bklit/chart-brush`
States clearly that the brush is not available through the registry today
Mentions the chart's xDomain / xDomainSlotCount props or the brush docs as a path forward

evals.prompt: Make the bar chart enter animation respect prefers-reduced-motion.
evals.expected_output: Notes that reduced motion is only partially handled internally (the bar grow/stagger is not), and gates animation with useReducedMotion — e.g. Bar animate={false}.
expectations: Does not claim bklit charts already fully respect prefers-reduced-motion
Uses `useReducedMotion` from motion/react (or a matchMedia check)
Disables the bar enter via `animate={false}` on Bar (not only `animationDuration={0}`, which leaves the stagger)
Keeps the default timing (1100ms, cubic-bezier(0.85, 0, 0.15, 1)) when motion is allowed
